Subject: FinHealth - Security & Private/VPC deployment follow-up

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights:
- FinHealth requires HIPAA support for PHI workloads and has a GDPR program for EU customers.
- SOC 2: you indicated a Type II audit is in progress with expected completion Q4 2026.
- Primary concerns: network isolation (VPC + private endpoints), key management (KMS/HSM), audit logs, and data residency controls.
- Interested in Private (VPC) deployment or a dedicated on-prem option; would like an example deployment diagram and details on air-gapped options.

Next steps (from Redwood):
1) I attached our standard vendor security questionnaire (FinHealth_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) — please confirm this is the right format and we'll start filling in answers.
2) Attached is a high-level deployment diagram (redwood-deployment-diagram.png) as a starting point — our infra team can produce an architecture tailored to your VPC/CIDR and peering model.
3) Monica (cc) will own the vendor security questionnaire and provide SOC 2 artifacts pointers (report summary, controls map).
4) Dev (cc) will follow up with specifics on KMS/HSM integrations, encryption at rest/in transit, and air-gapped deployment constraints.
5) Can we schedule a 30m follow-up next week to review answers and go over a tailored diagram? I proposed 2026-07-22 or 2026-07-23.

Please reply with your preferred follow-up time and any additional stakeholders to include (legal, procurement, internal security).

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: FinHealth_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire_v1.pdf, redwood-deployment-diagram.png

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the summary — this captures the discussion well. A few clarifications: 
- SOC 2: correct, we're mid-audit and expecting Type II in Q4. In the meantime, Procurement will want answers to the vendor questionnaire and any relevant SOC 2 interim evidence.
- HIPAA: we will need Business Associate Agreement language and confirmation that logs/audit trails are available for compliance review.
- Deployment preferences: prefer a VPC/private deployment with customer-managed KMS. If an on-prem/air-gapped option exists, please include constraints/certainty levels.

I'll loop in our compliance contact (compliance@finhealth.com) and procurement if we confirm moving forward.

For the follow-up, 2026-07-22 at 10:00 AM PT works on our side.

Best,
Alice Jenkins
